bank.likelihood_units: physical delta-state Gaussian density including log determinant
bank.conditioning: current state and executed action only; frozen v71 input scaling

window16.mode_weights: uniform-prior softmax of 16-step MEAN log densities; tempered diagnostic weights, not sequential belief
window16.alternative: equal mixture of four known changed modes versus normal

recursive.transition_prior: (1-h)*previous posterior + h/5; uniform redraw including same mode
recursive.mode_weights: recursive finite-mode posterior from untempered transition log densities
recursive.history_reset: independent trajectory only; persists across episode reset
recursive.departure_signal: softplus(log(mean changed posterior mass / normal posterior mass)); not a Bayes factor

limitations: One source training seed, mild known profiles and privileged offline simulator labels.
A fixed-model posterior; conditional Gaussian approximation errors can produce confident wrong modes.
Previously inspected updating and frozen traces are development replays; no closed-loop return evidence.
